findings.what: The 14 new detector IDs are not wired into the real recommendation/execution catalogue; legacy APIs still contain only six M1 IDs.
findings.why: The exact 20-detector catalogue cannot execute or be recommended against a valid prepared case.

findings.what: Recommendation delegates to the six-detector legacy recommender and has no user-package root.
findings.why: User SQL detectors and the 14 new built-ins are not recommended alongside the built-ins.

findings.what: Missing required metadata is filled with empty defaults instead of rejected.
findings.why: Malformed detector packages pass the trust boundary without the documented metadata contract.

findings.what: Many new detector queries are LIMIT 0 placeholders with no useful behavior.
findings.why: The required 14 new detectors need deterministic, fixture-backed behavior.

findings.what: Tests do not cover valid prepared-case execution, complete recommendation, user onboarding, metadata rejection, or fixture results.
findings.why: The green suite misses the acceptance-critical integration seams.

evidence.command: env UV_CACHE_DIR=/private/tmp/anomaly-uv-cache uv run --extra test pytest -q tests/test_detector_registry.py

evidence.output: 44 files scanned; zero automated findings; manual audit found five blockers.

findings.what: Missing or incomplete case roots trigger a synthetic lead-return path and approved=True bypasses Gate A and real execution.
findings.why: The registry can fabricate provenance-bearing leads without bounded detector execution.

findings.what: Symlinked metadata and query files are followed.
findings.why: Validated content and provenance can diverge and package boundaries can escape.

findings.what: Sensitive-output handling does not enforce metadata-driven redaction for arbitrary sensitive values.
findings.why: Permitted SQL output can persist sensitive values outside the narrow token regex.

findings.what: Required metadata fields are defaulted rather than validated.
The registry discovers 20 detectors but execution authorizes only six legacy IDs.
findings.why: Approval and executable implementation do not correspond.

slices: Enforce complete required metadata and reject symlinked metadata/query files plus executable files in SQL-only packages.
Unify the authoritative 20-detector catalogue across recommendation and real prepared-case execution, including discovered user SQL packages.
Require Gate A receipts for every approved execution and remove synthetic lead fabrication.
Replace all 14 placeholder detector queries with deterministic fixture-backed behavior and enforce metadata-driven sensitive-output redaction.
